question:
Select the option that can be used as one-word substitute for the given group of words

A policy that separates people on the basis of race
solution:
The correct answer is: **Apartheid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Apartheid"** refers to a policy or system of segregation or discrimination on grounds of race, particularly in South Africa during the 20th century. (नस्लभेद की नीति)

 
 
• **Example:** The system of apartheid in South Africa was abolished in 1994, bringing an end to racial segregation.
 
 
 
• **Explanation:** In English, apartheid is used to describe racial separation and discrimination, especially as it was institutionalized in South Africa. In Hindi, it translates to "नस्लभेद।"
 
 
• **Example:** Nelson Mandela fought against apartheid and became a symbol of resistance to racial oppression.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Apartheid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Apartacy** (कोई मान्यता प्राप्त शब्द नहीं): This is not a valid English word. Hence, it is irrelevant to the context.
 
• **Aposide** (कोई मान्यता प्राप्त शब्द नहीं): This is also not a valid English word and does not relate to the given context.
 
• **Apiary** (मधुमक्खी पालन स्थल): A place where bees are kept, especially for the production of honey.
 
 
• **Example:** The farmer built an apiary at the edge of his field to harvest fresh honey.
